    Profile

    Nicaea is a princess carrying the ancient royal bloodine from the Indivia Belt. She is able to synchronize with sacred beasts and use their powers to counter the beasts of sin. It is a dangerous technique, but as a royal, she is willing to stand up to danger for her people.

    Origin: Indivia Belt
    Gender: Female
    Height: 156cm
    Weight: 44kg
    Birthday: Jan 16
    Blood Type: Type Ki
    Zodiac: Moon of the Bright Knight
    Likes: People living peacefully together
    Hobbies: Chatting
    Illust: トマル（G-ROW）
    CV: 薄井友里
